description: This file defines a static utility class 'ImageValidators' that provides methods for validating image files based on size and extension checks in the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: ImageValidators
classes.description: A static class providing image validation methods such as size and extension validation.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates whether the input byte array represents a valid image by size and extension.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension of the provided filename is among the accepted image formats (.jpg, .png, .gif, .jpeg).
